breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for a dry sky to start. Fierce calm is Thursday composure under a washout: charge first, body second, two must-dos, quiet admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Thursday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Rain outside; tempo inside. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.hed: Seal the day before you open it
grimoire.body: Before the king spoke, he set the circle. Breath marks the edge. Body fills the center. Only then do the desks get a hearing. A day without a seal leaks.
grimoire.practice: After four rounds of box breathing, say once under your breath: ‘This threshold is mine.’ Then start the 3-minute opener. Do not check mail until both are done.

lesson.oneLiner: An always-on agent is only as good as the stop-rule.
beats: Dot = persistent agent in its own cloud VM, not a chat tab you babysit.
Launch gate: Pro / Business Premium in eligible markets; Enterprise beta off until an admin turns it on.
Useful jobs: watch feedback, draft a fix, open a PR, flag for review — not unsupervised spend.
Write three lines before you turn one on: what it does alone, when it asks, what it never does.
@mmmik000 rule: if you cannot name the stop, do not start the agent.
lesson.takeaway: Ship the boundary first. The agent is the second move.
